title: Magento 2 cache warmer: a bash playbook that survives reboots
lede: It is 21:14 on a Friday, you ran cache:flush, and the next visitor waits four seconds. Here is the two-hour bash warmer a Dutch agency now ships on every store.
hero_alt: Overhead photo of a Magento cache warmer playbook on graph paper with manila folder, crontab strip, brass plate, wax seal.
